riders: Mind Spike is not an ordinary weapon attack, unarmed strike, spell, or Attack action. A weapon, unarmed strike, natural weapon, martial Subpath, Recorded Art, or Forged Technique can deliver or modify Mind Spike only when its Source Rule expressly says so. A martial description does not grant Extra Attack, martial weapon proficiency, weapon delivery, physical damage, or permission to substitute an attack roll for Mind Spike's Wisdom saving throw.

riders: Read the Spirit (Action, your Spiritual Sense range): choose one perceived soul, spirit or spiritual effect and learn its broad category, relative Source CL and stability/concealment. This is narrative information; the GM adjudicates it directly (no separate reveal channel on the table).

riders: Soul Gaze does not automatically reveal a protected Soul Anchor, a spirit's complete Nature or Bond contract, Secret or divine identity, or a concealed effect whose Source Rule defeats ordinary spiritual diagnosis -- the GM adjudicates those and any contested Cultivation Check.

Once on each of your turns, when a creature in the Domain fails a saving throw against one of your Spirit Awakening Path or Subpath features, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on it without additional cost.

riders: Unfading Marks, Revealed Spirits, Subpath Domain Expression and Domain Collision are not automated: the table does not track which Resonance Marks or spirits are inside a moving 30-foot aura, or a second Domain's collision priority. The GM applies them.

Domain Pressure itself is automated: on each of your turns, the first creature that fails a saving throw while standing inside your live Domain aura, against one of your own Spirit Awakening Path or Subpath features, suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect of your choice for free; the table asks you which effect when it happens.

Soul Vessel creates a Spirit Cultivation Asset with its own AC, Hit Points and immunities, and a Vessel Imprint with direction-sensing, unfading-mark and shared-benefit rules -- the table does not track non-actor assets or the imprint's bookkeeping. The GM tracks the Vessel and resolves the Charisma saving throw an unwilling Vessel Imprint target makes.

effects.evidence: You are invisible to ordinary sight but visible to spiritual perception and spirit-revealing effects.

riders: While Astral Projection lasts, the table blocks attacks, hostile techniques, Domains, Companion commands, items and other physical actions. Perception, movement and free dismissal remain available; damage ends the projection. The table still has one position: the GM must track the Unconscious body's position and vulnerability, spiritual visibility, telepathy, hovering flight, passing through up to 5 feet of nonmagical material, the 300-foot/1-mile tether, blocked soul routes and Incapacitation when return is trapped. Do not treat the body as an invisible, moving combatant.

Soul Splitting is GM-run. The table's rules button creates no fragment and spends no action or Resonance. To activate it, the GM must spend your Action and 8 Resonance once and place one fragment in a legal empty space within 30 feet for the scene. The GM tracks its defenses, Hit Points, movement, 300-foot tether and destruction backlash. Echo Spike, Maintain Pressure, Guard Soul and Subpath Expressions remain GM-run: choose only one once on each of your turns after spending Resonance on a Spirit Awakening Path or Subpath feature or using Mind Spike.
Second Origin (choosing the fragment as a feature's point of origin) needs the same untracked fragment position; the GM measures range/area/cover from it by hand.

For 1 hour, see invisible creatures and through magical darkness within 60 feet, and sense active supernatural energy within 120 feet. This does not reveal dormant abilities, thoughts, memories or future actions.
Heavenly Analysis and sensing through physical materials are not automated yet.

At Cultivation Level 17, Circulating Golden Core lets you choose two different benefits after a successfully resolved Qi spend. Movement is 10 feet, Temporary Hit Points are twice your Proficiency Bonus, and Armament movement is 20 feet. Stable Core's hostile Qi-loss protection still needs to be applied by hand.

Not automated: combat/ext/qi_path.py's Golden Core Form condition holds one chosen Form at a time. A genuinely simultaneous second Form (CL20, both Perfected) needs a second tracked slot and doubled turn_start/circulating handling; only Lingyue Frostveil and Lingfeng Frostblade (CL20) have it. Flagged as a follow-up, not built this pass.

effects.evidence: At the start of each of your turns, regain 5 Qi.

riders: At the start of your turn, regain 5 Qi without using an action or spending Qi.
Immortal Circulation runs at the start of each of your turns, and only then: while an effect suppresses it, or after your Qi is spent again, it does not carry over.

Nine Heavens Gaze is always active: Truesight 60 feet and Qi Sensing 120 feet, with no action or Qi cost. Twin Domain Armaments, Twin Assault, Twin Guard and their Remote Origins are not automated yet. Complete Cultivated Response and all simultaneous Form interactions still need full verification.

Sovereign Identity's contested Wisdom save only triggers against an external effect that targets the bearer -- it is not an action the bearer takes, so no compiled action exists for it; the GM rolls it when an appropriate effect lands. Continue Without the Body (0 HP with the soul free), the 28-day Immortal Restoration Capacity and Ageless Soul are outside a single fight's scope and are GM-tracked.
